user.title: Xthings Locks
user.description: Sign in with the same email and password as the Xthings Home app.

account.title: Xthings account
account.description:
Use the same email and password as the Xthings Home app. That account is used to list locks and poll status (battery, RSSI, locked/unlocked).

Lock and unlock need OpenAPI: create a client in the app (My Account → OpenAPI), add Application credentials in Home Assistant first, then authorize on the next screen. The required redirect URI is in the integration documentation.

pick_implementation.title: OpenAPI
pick_implementation.description: Authorize Xthings OpenAPI so Home Assistant can lock and unlock over Wi-Fi. If this step is skipped, you will only get status entities.

error.invalid_auth: Login failed. Use the Xthings Home app email and password, not the OpenAPI client id.

abort.already_configured: This Xthings account is already configured
abort.reauth_successful: OpenAPI linked. Lock/unlock over Wi-Fi is enabled.
abort.missing_credentials: Add Xthings OpenAPI application credentials first: Settings → Devices & services → Application credentials. Client id and secret come from the Xthings Home app (My Account → OpenAPI). See the integration documentation for the redirect URI.
abort.no_url_available: No URL available. Set Home Assistant URL under Settings → System → Network.

application_credentials.description: Create a client in the Xthings Home app (My Account → OpenAPI). Follow the [documentation]({docs_url}) for the redirect URI and scope, then paste the client id and secret here.
